Use case: stylized-concept. Create a SMALL LOW-RESOLUTION ACTUAL GAME SPRITE sample sheet for a Korean retro top-down online RPG, inspired by the simple in-game sprite proportions of The Kingdom of the Winds: Yeon, NOT its promotional illustrations. New original characters and equipment. Transparent background. Exactly SIX tiny full-body characters arranged in a spacious 3-column 2-row grid. Read this constraint literally: each figure has only 24 x 36 LOGICAL PIXELS of information, enlarged with nearest-neighbor to roughly 144 x 216 display pixels. Every visible pixel cluster is a coarse square block ~6x6 pixels. Draw as if in a 24x36 pixel editor. 12 to 16 solid colors per sprite, one dark outline pixel, 2 tones per material, flat shading, absolutely no gradients, texture, dithering, ornate details, embroidery, lighting, glows, particles or auras. Extremely simple face: two single dark dot eyes, tiny mouth, simple solid hair cap. Small round head, narrow short torso, short straight legs, 2.5-head-tall proportions. NOT big muscular heads/bodies, NOT caricature portraits, NOT detailed western fantasy character concept art. Viewed slightly from ABOVE, front-down facing, feet on same baseline, relaxed idle stance, suitable for tilemap walking. Equipment is modest and readable, weapon no taller than body. Top left: buzz-cut swordsman, plain red tunic, brown boots, simple straight gray sword at side. Top middle: curly brown-haired warrior, orange tunic, small plain gray axe. Top right: black-haired bespectacled mage, plain green robe, simple wooden staff with blue square crystal. Bottom left: smiling brown bowl-cut bard, teal tunic, tiny brown lute with just 2 string pixels. Bottom middle: black backwards cap moustached druid, plain moss cloak, short brown oak staff with 3 leaf pixels. Bottom right: wavy black-haired moustached priest, plain white robe with coral stole, small gray mace and brown closed book. Leave lots of empty transparent space, no labels, no text, no borders. Priority is truly coarse low pixel count and ordinary cute old MMORPG NPC look. These are usable small sprite visual designs, NOT fancy illustration that happens to have jagged edges.
